description: Bus Occupancy - Aug 2016 to Jan 2017 is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. This dataset provides an indicator of bus occupancy for individual bus services during three separate one week periods between August 2016 and January 2017. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are TPA, bus, historic, occupancy. It offers 25 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2023-08-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
